description.value: The Fraserview Branch is one of Vancouver Public Library's neighbourhood branches, serving the Fraserview and Killarney communities in southeast Vancouver. As a publicly operated library, it offers free access to books, digital resources, and community programming. Touring cyclists passing through this part of the city may find it a useful stop for rest, Wi-Fi, and public services.

OSM provides internet_access=wlan supporting a Wi-Fi claim, but all other amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are unconfirmed. The OSM record is unambiguous — a public library branch operated by Vancouver Public Library at a real civic address.
